Prepare country-prioritization source data

prepare_GSAP_ctry_prioritization_data.Rd

Pulls the existing sirfunctions KPI calculations needed for the first country-prioritization stage. This function does not download POLIS data; the caller supplies the in-memory result of get_all_polio_data(). It also keeps the positives data available for the later virus-risk step and reads the long-format WUENIC workbook supplied outside POLIS.

Usage

prepare_GSAP_ctry_prioritization_data(
  raw_data,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  immunity_data = NULL,
  immunity_file = NULL,
  wuenic_year = NULL,
  risk_table = NULL,
  lab_locs = NULL,
  ctry_sf = NULL,
  lab_data = NULL
)

Arguments

raw_data

list Output of get_all_polio_data().

start_date

Date or date-like string. Start of the analysis period.

end_date

Date or date-like string. End of the analysis period.

immunity_data

tibble Optional already-read WUENIC data.

immunity_file

str Optional WUENIC workbook path. Used when immunity_data is NULL.

wuenic_year

integer Optional WUENIC year to use when immunity_data is read from immunity_file. If NULL, the reader uses its default year-selection behavior.

risk_table

tibble Optional current country-risk table. Defaults to the EDAV CTRY_RISK_CAT table.

lab_locs

tibble Optional laboratory-location table. Defaults to the EDAV laboratory-location data.

ctry_sf

Optional country spatial layer. Defaults to raw_data$global.ctry when present.

lab_data

tibble Optional cleaned laboratory data containing DateStoolReceivedinLab. When supplied, this date is used for the C2 onset-to-laboratory timeliness indicator.

Value

A list containing the source inputs, existing KPI tables, and surveillance_indicators table with the indicators needed by the later scoring step.
